notes.title: [With My Past] will be participating in Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
The pixel-art narrative puzzle game [With My Past] will be participating in Eastern Game Fest Sale 2025 from from 10:00 AM (PT), April 23 to 10:00 AM (PT), May 2, 2025 — now at its lowest global price ever!
During the event, dive into [With My Past] and enjoy a 25% discount!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44458224/72bf52d237e2896aff21c7c1f8bb9df03c4aca23.jpg[/img]

“As I move forward in life, how should I face my past?”
 Listen to the voice within and unravel one puzzle after another, gradually confronting your memories as you progress through the game.
Feel free to join our official discord group: https://discord.gg/XYREeepvW8

notes.title: Free Major Update Coming!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

[b]The real full version is coming now! [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44458224/1e8eef94dda0eb2614d26e972228b60845ec3415.jpg[/img]

This major update brings B-side levels specifically designed for puzzle aficionados. These levels span five major chapters, each featuring around 10 sub-levels filled with challenges and enjoyment. These levels will test players' problem-solving skills and strategic thinking, delivering endless puzzle-solving fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44458224/1d699b99a98756da32ac92e0c18ff4d2eee28f48.jpg[/img]

At the same time, the game is now available at its lowest discount ever, which will last until the end of the summer sale. Don't miss out!

notes.title: Patch Note v1.0.1
notes.notes:
-Fixed the bug causing cloud saves to fail.
-Fixed the bug preventing access to Chapter Four in the Japanese version.
-Fixed the bug causing infinite reloading of chapters when restarting chapters in the in-game menu.
-Fixed the bug causing the dog to fall from above in some levels of Chapter Four when restarting the level.
-Fixed the bug causing the game to freeze outside the map during the final performance of the epilogue.
-Fixed some typos in the text.

notes.title: Demo V0.8.12 Patch Note
notes.notes:
- Added Korean localization.
- Optimized some level puzzle designs, making the difficulty curve of the first chapter smoother.
- Adjusted some texts and their corresponding localization translations.
- Fixed bugs where some levels could get stuck outside the map.
- Added animation effects for switches, timed doors, and other mechanisms.
- Added sound effects for mechanisms such as dogs and pressure plates.
- Optimized the vibration effects for controllers.

notes.title: Demo V0.8.8 Alpha Patch Note
notes.notes:
-Fixed the issue where the protagonist didn't stop sitting on the chair at the end of Chapter 1.
-Fixed the problem where resetting the level at the end of Chapter 1 caused abnormal background music transitions.
-Fixed the issue where lightly pushing the joystick caused the protagonist to drift slowly.
In the main menu, you can now navigate to the page with the development team's contact information.
-Added a settings menu, allowing you to switch window modes, individually adjust the volume of music and sound effects, and set keyboard keys.
-Fixed a bug in Level 1A.15 where resetting the level caused the platform to take an exceptionally long time to break.
-Fixed the issue where only one motor of the controller vibrated when the controller vibrated.
